backtest_protocol.execution_model: Selected source trades use already slippage-adjusted next-open entry and ten-trading-day exit PnL. The overlay is booked on each paper exit date against the canonical core baseline equity curve.

baseline_caveat.note: The current replay aggregate baseline matches the documented accepted core baseline within tolerance.
The current replay aggregate baseline matches the documented accepted core baseline within tolerance.

gate3.note: No core production filter was added. Survival rates are inherited from the canonical core baseline plus default-off paper overlay.

gate4.rationale: The fixed share-contraction plus FCF-yield combo did not clear Gate 4 and/or the accepted low-liability comparator, so no production or shared policy change is retained.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry / candidate_pool: shareholder-yield plus cash-generation evidence should prefer companies funding growth without dilution and with real cash support.

2_history_check.current_difference: This is not another threshold retune. It tests one fixed intersection of two prior free-data mechanisms and requires deconcentration plus beating the accepted exp-20260528-017 comparator.
2_history_check.exp-20260601-002: share contraction was strong but rejected for APP-dominated concentration
2_history_check.exp-20260601-004: earnings yield was positive but concentration failed
2_history_check.exp-20260601-019: FCF yield was positive but rejected for concentration and baseline caveat
2_history_check.exp-20260609-006: quality-gated top1 improved aggregate but failed late window, concentration, and accepted comparator

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three standard windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL; all three windows improve; >=20 target trades across all windows; trades in all three windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; max single positive share <=0.40 and HHI <=0.30; baseline matches docs; after metrics beat accepted exp-20260528-017 in aggregate and no window regresses.

hypothesis: Entry / candidate-pool alpha: filed-date SEC Companyfacts rows showing both diluted-share contraction and >=3% free-cash-flow yield may isolate shareholder-yield, cash-generative growth+RS candidates and reduce the concentration that invalidated the individual Companyfacts value leads.
interpretation: The fixed share-contraction plus FCF-yield combo did not clear Gate 4 and/or the accepted low-liability comparator, so no production or shared policy change is retained.

llm_metrics.blocker_relation: LLM soft-ranking data was skipped; this tests a free deterministic SEC data edge.

next_retry_requires: Only retry with a genuinely broader free-data candidate pool or forward closed rows, not by loosening the same thresholds on these windows.
No same-window threshold/scalar retry of share contraction, FCF yield, earnings yield, or quality-gated top1 Companyfacts variants without new data or a new causal mechanism.

parameters.fcf_yield_rule: latest filed operating_cash_flow minus abs(capex), annualized by duration_days, divided by signal-day close times latest shares_diluted; minimum >= 3%
locked_variables: accepted fundamental_growth_rs thresholds and top1 selection
parameters.share_count_rule: latest shares_diluted filed <= signal_date versus same fiscal period prior fiscal year <= -0.5% YoY change

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: No same-window threshold/scalar retry of share contraction, FCF yield, earnings yield, or quality-gated top1 Companyfacts variants without new data or a new causal mechanism.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Only retry with a genuinely broader free-data candidate pool or forward closed rows, not by loosening the same thresholds on these windows.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The intersection was too sparse to evaluate as a durable candidate-pool edge. Combining two individually interesting Companyfacts fields removed too many source rows.
